programs.program_name: Elective Pay for clean energy tax credits (IRA sec. 6417)
programs.agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Internal Revenue Service
programs.municipal_role: direct claimant (state and local governments are applicable entities)
programs.asset_classes: solar; storage; EV charging; clean vehicles; geothermal
programs.status_note: 2025 federal tax legislation changed eligibility timelines for several clean electricity credits; confirm current dates for each credit.

evidence.note: Requires pre-filing registration and a return claiming the credit; substantiation concerns eligibility, cost basis and labor and content rules, not performance. Investment credits are cost-based; production credits use metered output, which a future version should code separately.
No public entity-level or project-level results; tax return information is confidential by statute.
No baseline or outcome measure.
Page does not describe 2025 statutory changes; status note requires author confirmation from Treasury or IRS guidance.

programs.program_name: Low or No Emission Vehicle Program
programs.asset_classes: transit fleet; charging and fueling facilities

evidence.source: FTA, Information collection notice for Buses and Bus Facilities and Low or No Emission Programs, FR Doc. 2026-05918 (Mar. 26, 2026)
evidence.note: Post-award reporting covers milestones, fund use, equipment specifications, compliance certifications and periodic performance reports; no emissions or energy outcome reporting described.

evidence.source: FTA, National Transit Database 2023 Energy Consumption data product
evidence.note: NTD publishes energy consumption by mode, type of service and fuel type. It is not tied to individual grants, so it supports only aggregate observation of fleet energy use.
No baseline requirement described.

evidence.source: EPA, Clean School Bus vehicle disposition evidence webinar slides (Mar. 10, 2026)
evidence.note: Outputs are verified with photographic scrappage evidence and signed statements; final performance report or close out form. No operational, energy or emissions outcome reporting described.
No statement that delivered results are published. Award lists exist but awards are not results under the coding protocol.
No baseline or outcome measure.

programs.status_note: FEMA announced the end of BRIC on Apr. 4, 2025. On Dec. 11, 2025 a federal court ruled the termination unlawful and permanently enjoined it; as of Feb. 2026 no restoration timetable existed.

evidence.source: Congressional Research Service, IN12609, BRIC: Recent Developments (Feb. 19, 2026)
evidence.note: Cancellation, litigation and injunction history as summarized in status_note; about $1 billion of $4.67 billion selected for FY2020 to FY2023 obligated as of Jan. 29, 2026.

evidence.source: OpenFEMA, Hazard Mitigation Assistance Projects v4
evidence.note: Projects carry an ex ante benefit cost ratio, with 1.0 or greater treated as cost effective. This is a modeled estimate of avoided losses, not a measured result.

evidence.source: OpenFEMA, Hazard Mitigation Assistance Projects v4
evidence.note: Project-level records including BRIC, with estimated benefit fields and status; bulk CSV, JSON and Parquet; API; updated daily.

evidence.source: OpenFEMA, Hazard Mitigation Assistance Projects v4
evidence.note: Benefit cost analysis uses a modeled no-action baseline; no measured post-event loss avoidance in this dataset.
